notes.title: Yuna and the Spirit Forest is Joining Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45632967/f5e323d8603275e051ae892a4dcca53ab047440e.png"][/img]

[/p][p]Hello, everyone![/p][p]We are RavenRaiders, the development team behind [b]Yuna and the Spirit Forest[/b]. We have some incredibly exciting news to share with all of you who have been eagerly waiting![/p][p]We are thrilled to announce that [b]Yuna and the Spirit Forest[/b] will be participating in the upcoming [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], starting on [b]October 20th![/b][/p][p]This is a huge milestone for us, and to celebrate, we will be releasing our very first [b]playable demo[/b] exclusively for the event. This will be your first chance to step into the mystical world we've been creating, meet Yuna, and interact with the enchanting spirits.[/p][p]Mark your calendars for [b]October 20th![/b] Don't forget to [b]Wishlist and Follow[/b] the game so you don't miss the moment the demo goes live.[/p][p][b]We promise to be more communicative with you all going forward.[/b] Your feedback on the demo will be invaluable to us.[/p][p][/p][p]Best, 
The RavenRaiders[/p]
